priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Thunderstrike Ward, and Flametongue Weapon at all times.
Cast Ascendance as your primary burst cooldown, ideally when Stormkeeper is on cooldown (>15s remaining).
Cast Stormkeeper if Ascendance has more than 10s remaining or is currently active.
Cast Earthquake as your primary Maelstrom spender when facing 3 or more targets.
Cast Elemental Blast as a spender if Earthquake is not talented or if you are at exactly 3 targets.
Cast Tempest if the Master of the Elements buff is active to maximize its damage.
Cast Tempest if you are about to cap stacks (at 2 stacks) and have no Stormkeeper stacks active.
Use Chain Lightning to consume all Stormkeeper stacks.
Cast Voltaic Blaze if Purging Flames is active, prioritizing targets that need Flame Shock.
Cast Lava Burst if Lava Surge or Purging Flames is active, especially at 3 targets to trigger Master of the Elements.
Cast Flame Shock to refresh the DoT and trigger Master of the Elements if Ascendance is not active.
Cast Tempest as a high-priority generator and Chain Lightning as your primary filler.
Use Spiritwalker's Grace for movement; use Frost Shock or Voltaic Blaze as instant fillers if forced to move.
